The '''Animal Control Division''' was a branch of the [[Corellian Security Force]] dealing with wild and dangerous creatures.

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Animal Control Division is mentioned in several missions in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], hiring players to help hunting dangerous animals.
